description: The plot titled "Sparsity Ratio of SDPA Output, Threshold 1e-2" illustrates the sparsity ratio of SDPA output across different layers. The x-axis, labeled "Layer," is linear and ranges from 0 to 20, with tick labels at intervals of 5. The y-axis, labeled "Sparsity Ratio," is also linear and ranges from 0.0 to 1.0, with tick labels at intervals of 0.2. The plot features three lines: a dashed blue line representing the sparsity ratio before the gate, an orange dotted line representing the sparsity ratio after the gate, and a green dash-dot line representing the sparsity ratio after the average gate. The blue line starts at a sparsity ratio of approximately 0.03 and remains relatively flat across the layers. The orange line starts at a sparsity ratio of approximately 0.44 and shows a general decline with some fluctuations, ending at a value around 0.33. The green line starts at a sparsity ratio of approximately 0.33 and also shows a decline with fluctuations, ending at a value around 0.33. The plot does not include any peaks, declines, or steady trends beyond the data points provided.
